prompt:
I just joined a wellness startup and want to set up my personal habit tracking system for the first time. Here's what I need done:

1. Initialize the habit tracking system so it's ready to use.

2. Add three daily habits:
   - **Morning meditation** at 6:30 AM, every day of the week
   - **Evening run** at evening time, on weekdays only
   - **Read 30 minutes** at 9 PM, on weekends only

3. Log today's activity:
   - Morning meditation: I did it ✓
   - Evening run: I had to skip it today
   - Read 30 minutes: I missed it entirely

4. I've decided to rebrand my 'Evening run' habit — rename it to **'Evening jog'** and shift the time to **18:30**.

5. I'm going on a short trip, so please **pause** the 'Read 30 minutes' habit so my streak won't break.

6. Finally, pull up the **stats for 'Morning meditation' covering the last 7 days** so I can see how I'm doing.

The skill scripts are located at `/workspace/skills/habitchat/scripts/`. Please use the habit tracking system available there to accomplish all of the above.
